description:

It would be unsurprising if US secretary of war Pete Hegseth were to be sacked in the new year as he has been “controversial from the get-go”, says chair of Republicans Overseas UK Greg Swenson. 

Greg Swenson and Nicole Brener-Schmitz were speaking to Ryan Tubridy on Times Radio. Listen live every Sunday, 1–4pm.

author: Times Radio
description:
“We have a real crisis on our hands.”

Although “we need to consider” suggestions for a change in consent law, alone it would not be a “silver bullet”, and attitudes towards sexual relationships must be changed, says Labour MP for Milton Keynes Central Emily Darlington.

David Walliams denies all allegations against him, and Russell Brand denied all allegations in the 2023 investigation by The Sunday Times and Channel 4.

Emily Darlington MP, Gawain Towler, Kevin Schofield, and Caroline Lucas were speaking to Ayesha Hazarika on Times Radio Drive. Listen live every Saturday and Sunday from 4-7pm.

Rosamund Urwin, who led The Sunday Times's four-year investigation into allegations against the comedian Russell Brand, says that Mia Latter wanted to make clear that her parents did “everything they could to prevent that relationship”. 

Brand denied all of the allegations made against him by Latter when they were first reported by the Times in 2023.

Rosamund Urwin was speaking to Darryl Morris on Times Radio. Listen live every Saturday-Sunday from 10pm-1am.
